summary: The composer's model and actions, autosave, posting settings, the queue's settings, repeats, images and video.

src/lib/pendingCompose.js.note: sessionStorage is a KeyValueStore the app clears at launch.

src/posting/autosave.js.note: The web's module-level Maps are AutosaveSession (.shared, or one per test). createAutosaver's pagehide/visibilitychange listeners have no logic-side equivalent: the app calls Autosaver.flush() when its scene goes to the background.

src/posting/composer/languages.js.note: Intl.DisplayNames' English names are tables taken from Node 22's ICU (78.3), held to the fixture: every two- and three-letter code it names, CLDR's names for a language in a region or script (pt-BR 'Brazilian Portuguese'), and the script and region names it puts after a language ('English (Latin, United States)'). Not reproduced: a variant ICU knows by name ('de-AT-1996' is 'Austrian German (German orthography of 1996)'; the port writes the variant's code), the dialect names of three-letter or numeric aliases ('eng-US', 'en-840') and deprecated regions ('ab-SU'), and extlang tags ('zh-yue'). A locale that isn't English names through Foundation, which can differ from ICU. Sorting goes through VirgaPosting's LocaleCompare (ComposerLanguages.compareNames), to move to VirgaCore's consolidated localeCompare at the merge.

src/posting/composer/loaders.js.note: isOwnThreadRow is a private stand-in with library/model.js's code until the library's port (VirgaPosting/Library) is merged; the merge replaces it.

src/posting/composer/media.js.note: pastedImageFiles reads the clipboard's DataTransfer on the web; the port takes the pasteboard's items (PastedItem) and its text, which VirgaUI reads from UIPasteboard. The sorting, notes and names are held to the fixture.

src/posting/lib/images.js.note: The pixel work (browser-image-compression's re-encode and decodeImageSize's createImageBitmap/ decode) is the ImageEncoder protocol, which VirgaUI implements over ImageIO; prepareImage's decisions (budgets, options, refusals, name, type, aspect ratio, the timeout) and uploadImage are ported and held to the fixture over a scripted encoder.

src/posting/lib/video.js.note: Nothing here needs AVFoundation: the bytes are the app's, sent through HTTPTransport, tokens minted by VideoServiceAuthAgent (XRPCAgent). videoServiceUrl prefixes a route without its '/' as the pathname setter does; other pathname-setter escaping isn't reproduced (routes are constants).

src/posting/settings.js.note: usePostingSettings is PostingSettingsModel (@MainActor @Observable; the hook's reset is PostingSettingsStore.resetPostingSettings). The web's cross-tab 'storage' listener has no counterpart: one app, and every write goes out on the posting events bus.
